items.title: Joseph 'One Eyed Babe' Phillips Interview, 1957-03-27
items.q: A band by the name of the Magnolia Band. I was playing guitar... It was a young man by the name of Casimir Matthews. He was the leader of the band.

ctx.x: And, who was the leader of the band?
Well, it was a first cousin of mine. It was a young man by the name of Casimir Matthews. I was the leader.
